problem.problem:
Charlie is green. Charlie is kind. Erin is blue. Erin is kind. Fiona is green. Gary is blue. Gary is furry. Gary is green. Gary is kind. Gary is round. If someone is round and kind then they are green. All green, round people are blue. Round people are big. If someone is kind then they are furry. All blue people are kind. If someone is green then they are big. If Erin is cold and Erin is green then Erin is blue. Cold, blue people are kind. All green, big people are round.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Fiona is round.

Predicates:
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?

Facts:
Green(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is green.
Kind(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is kind.
Blue(Erin, True) ::: Erin is blue.
Kind(Erin, True) ::: Erin is kind.
Green(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is green.
Blue(Gary, True) ::: Gary is blue.
Furry(Gary, True) ::: Gary is furry.
Green(Gary, True) ::: Gary is green.
Kind(Gary, True) ::: Gary is kind.
Round(Gary, True) ::: Gary is round.

Rules:
Round($x, True) && Kind($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: If someone is round and kind then they are green.
Green($x, True) && Round($x, True) >>> Blue($x, True) ::: All green, round people are blue.
Round($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: Round people are big.
Kind($x, True) >>> Furry($x, True) ::: If someone is kind then they are furry.
Blue($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: All blue people are kind.
Green($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: If someone is green then they are big.
Cold(Erin, True) && Green(Erin, True) >>> Blue(Erin, True) ::: If Erin is cold and Erin is green then Erin is blue.
Cold($x, True) && Blue($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: Cold, blue people are kind.
Green($x, True) && Big($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: All green, big people are round.

Query:
Round(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is round.
